text: Avoid combination – NSAIDs like naproxen can raise lithium plasma levels and reduce renal lithium clearance, increasing the risk of lithium toxicity [naproxen:drug_interactions:6, naproxen:drug_interactions:7]. The mechanism involves NSAID inhibition of renal prostaglandin synthesis, which diminishes lithium excretion and leads to higher serum concentrations [naproxen:drug_interactions:6]. Therefore, co‑administration requires careful monitoring for signs of lithium toxicity.
